description: Default timing profile. Suitable for a remote site with a co-located safety authority and a direct command path.

rationale.tokenLifetimeS: Intruder budget, not exposure averaging. 5000 ms token + 100 ms detect + 50 ms defocus + 250 ms ramp = 5400 ms worst-case unsafe duration. At a declared 250 m/s that is 1350 m of intruder travel, which becomes the required dead-man buffer under [R-S-024]. Exposure averaging is NOT the constraint: at 41 W/m2 the ICNIRP 30-minute average tolerates a 439 s excursion.
rationale.tokenRefreshHz: 1 Hz gives 4 tolerated consecutive losses at a 5 s lifetime; a link dropping 5 consecutive seconds should not be carrying megawatts. Also sits ~4x outside the 239 ms GEO round trip, whereas 10 Hz would put the refresh interval inside it.
rationale.probeLevelFractionOfPublicLimit: 20 dB below the general-public reference level means a total mispoint is non-hazardous by two orders of magnitude while leaving 20 dB of dynamic range for a closed pointing loop. UNVERIFIED as to loop SNR adequacy - see OBJECTIONS.md O-2.
rationale.corridorHalfAngleDeg: A 2 km aperture at 547 km slant range subtends 0.21 deg. +/-0.2 deg is approximately 'on the aperture' for LEO. Far coarser than required at GEO - see OBJECTIONS.md O-4.
rationale.holdS: A dwell at ~10% of committed rate is where a pointing error, an atmospheric surprise or a metering fault reveals itself at a power level where it is diagnostic rather than dangerous.
